actions.action: Separate naming directions from wording variants
actions.mechanism: Group by the constraint addressed and rationale, not spelling similarity; keep every direction visible without popularity ordering.
actions.implementation: Add rationale and constraint fields. Allow reversible, user-confirmed grouping; retain immutable originals and private author links. Show direction headers even when variants collapse.
actions.check: Submit two similar names with different rationales; verify both directions remain visible and each original suggestion is recoverable.
actions.risk: Forced categories could obscure suggestions addressing multiple constraints.

actions.action: Make rejections conditional on versioned constraints
actions.mechanism: Link each rejection to its explanation and constraint version so changed assumptions can reopen consideration.
actions.implementation: Store rejection reasons and referenced constraints. On constraint edits, mark affected rejections 'needs review'; preserve previous decisions and notify reviewers without automatically reinstating names.
actions.check: Reject a name for a stated constraint, then change that constraint; verify review reopens while unrelated rejections remain unchanged.
actions.risk: Broad constraint edits may create excessive review notifications.

actions.action: Give late suggestions an anonymous first review
actions.mechanism: A separate review queue conceals authorship and popularity signals until reviewers independently assess rationale and constraint fit.
actions.implementation: Store authorship behind access controls. Present unread suggestions in disclosed randomized order, regardless of arrival date; require a reason before marking one previously considered.
actions.check: Add a late alternative; verify its first-review payload excludes identity and endorsements, and dismissal requires a linked prior rationale.
actions.risk: Distinctive wording may reveal identity despite interface anonymity.

actions.action: Keep hard-constraint conflicts visible beside popular names
actions.mechanism: Separate constraint eligibility from enthusiasm; visible conflicts prompt deliberation without selecting or automatically eliminating candidates.
actions.implementation: Add a constraint checklist with pass, conflict, and unknown states plus evidence. Display unresolved hard-constraint conflicts on cards; require explanations for overrides, retaining dissent.
actions.check: Give a popular name a documented hard-constraint conflict; verify the warning persists despite endorsements and no winner is selected.
actions.risk: Disputed constraints could be weaponized; allow recorded challenges.
